```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4, dev = "png", dpi = 150)
source(file.path("..", "R", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(.repo_root, "R", "plot_helpers.R"))
```

Gene-set differential-expression by permutation against size-matched random
gene sets. `dstat` = summary statistics (observed vs null, Z, P); `dperm` = the
raw per-permutation draws (the null distributions behind the density plots).

```{r load}
# Summaries (always required) + raw draws (required for the density plots).
perm_all  <- data.table::fread(inputs("perm_all"))
perm_sub  <- data.table::fread(inputs("perm_subcluster"))
perm_meta <- data.table::fread(inputs("perm_metacluster"))
draws_all <- data.table::fread(inputs("perm_draws_all"))   # errors with a clear
draws_sub <- data.table::fread(inputs("perm_draws_sub"))   # message if the dperm
draws_meta<- data.table::fread(inputs("perm_draws_meta"))  # re-knit wasn't done
```

## All-dopa: null distributions per gene set

```{r density, fig.width=9, fig.height=3, results="asis"}
for (gs in sort(unique(draws_all$gene_set_name))) {
  cat("\n\n### ", gs, "\n\n", sep = "")
  gg <- plot_perm_density(draws_all, perm_all, gene_set = gs)
  print(gg); save_fig(gg, "03_Permutation", paste0("density_all_dopa-", gs), width = 9, height = 3)
}
```

## All-dopa: observed vs null (median Z)

```{r zdot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
d <- perm_all %>% dplyr::mutate(contrast = factor(CONTRAST_LABELS[contrast],
                                                  levels = unname(CONTRAST_LABELS)))
gg <- ggplot(d, aes(median_z_score, reorder(gene_set_name, median_z_score),
                    colour = contrast)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(CONTRAST_COLS), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "median Z score", y = NULL) + theme_submission()
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "03_Permutation", "zscore_dot_all_dopa", width = 7, height = 5)
```

## Per-subcluster z-score heatmap

```{r heat-sub, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
gg <- plot_perm_zscore_heatmap(perm_sub, cluster_levels = SUBCLUSTER_ORDER)
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "03_Permutation", "zscore_heatmap_per_subcluster", width = 11, height = 7)
```

## Per-metacluster z-score heatmap

```{r heat-meta, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
gg <- plot_perm_zscore_heatmap(perm_meta, cluster_levels = c("A","B","C","D"))
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "03_Permutation", "zscore_heatmap_per_metacluster", width = 7, height = 7)
```

## Consistency checks

```{r check, echo=TRUE}
# (1) z / p recompute from the summary columns.
chk <- perm_all %>% dplyr::mutate(
  z_ok = isTRUE(all.equal((data_median - perm_median)/perm_sd_median, median_z_score,
                          tolerance = 1e-6, check.attributes = FALSE)),
  p_ok = isTRUE(all.equal(pnorm(abs(median_z_score), lower.tail = FALSE), median_p_value,
                          tolerance = 1e-6, check.attributes = FALSE)))
cat("median_z_score recompute matches:", all(chk$z_ok, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("median_p_value recompute matches:", all(chk$p_ok, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# (2) dperm <-> dstat: draws reproduce perm_median / perm_sd_median.
agg <- draws_all %>% dplyr::group_by(gene_set_name, contrast, cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(pm = median(med), ps = sd(med), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(perm_all, by = c("gene_set_name","contrast","cluster"))
cat("draws reproduce perm_median (max |diff|):",
    round(max(abs(agg$pm - agg$perm_median), na.rm = TRUE), 5), "\n")
```
